title: From Locksmith to $1.2M ARR: The Solo Founder Who Stalled for Two Years Before Hiring
subtitle: Tim Bennetto spent a decade as a locksmith. His SaaS now clears $1.2M annually with a three-person team. The two-year plateau almost killed it.
description: Tim Bennetto taught himself to code, built Pallyy from scratch, stalled at $1.3k MRR for two years, then grew it to $1.2M ARR. This is the forensic breakdown of what happened during those flat years and the unconventional moves that followed.
